headline: New IDX Commodity 20 Index Launches, How Much Profit Compared to the IHSG?
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange has launched the IDX Commodity 20 index. It recorded a 48.22% gain in 2022, well ahead of the composite IHSG index.
why: The IHSG is Indonesia's main composite stock index, and thematic commodity indices track companies exposed to resource prices such as mining and energy.
original_headline: Indeks Baru IDX Comodity 20 Meluncur, Cuan Mana Dibanding IHSG?
